title: Unwrap
text: Unwrap signal phase, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Tolerance (radians)} sets the jump size, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input Columns and {Reset initial phase to zero for each input frame} sets the checking successive frames. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset initial phase to zero for each input frame
